rules.text:
THE RULES THESE BOARDS SET FOR THE WHOLE APP

LINES FOR ROWS, NEVER FOR COLUMNS. No cell anywhere declares a left or right border. Horizontal rules and zebra only.

ONE CONTROL HEIGHT — 34 px for every filter, select and search box in the app; 40 px for a field being edited in a form.

ONE DATE BOX WIDTH — 132 px, everywhere, tabular figures. A date box is never full-width and never guesses its size from its container.

MONEY BOX 120 px, right-aligned. Short code 104 px. Only a free-text reason grows to fill.

An edit box is sized to what goes in it. A 10-character date does not get a 600 px field.

KPI blocks are tiles across, never bars down. 78 px, not 216.

MISSING RENDERS AS — , never 0, and never -$0.00.

views.text:
CUSTOMERS AND VENDORS — BOTH VIEWS

Regular view is the table on boards 3 and 4. It is the default.

Master-detail is the second view, the same shape as the Driver Hub Home board: list on the left, the selected record filling the right.

One toggle, same position, same size on every list in the app.

Either way the list opens on parties with real money — 65 customers, 34 vendors. All is one click away and search always reaches all 1,249 and 623.
